card.name: Digits in dosing lookup tables
card.fires_on: The last digit of a number inside a long, regular table of numbers, such as units-to-mg or mcg conversions, where the next number in the sequence repeats or steps up. Also fires weakly on counting steps like Figure 4.

modes.label: Dose conversion tables
modes.description: Final digit of a row number in a units-to-mg or mcg chart.
modes.example: 19 19 units 6.3 mcg 20 20 units 6.7 mcg 21 2<<1>> units 7 mcg 22

modes.label: Weight or measurement tables
modes.description: Digit in a table of rising numeric values such as weights and doses.

modes.label: Counted sequence items
modes.description: A number or month in a listed series, like figure numbers or semesters.
modes.example: Figure 1 Figure 2 Figure 3 Figure <<4>> Figure 5 Figure 6

card.plain: It notices a number in the middle of a long table of rising values, like a dose conversion chart.
